decision.scope: The Kani verification lane's key and coproduct families under catherine-6g2 taken to full verification at the 8 GB / 300 s standard, and the lane's enforcement hardened: per-family partition entries landed for all four families (engine_key_findings, engine_coproduct_findings, engine_pullback_findings emit in walk order; the walkers consume a FindingSink instead of a Vec plus push_bounded), the key family's run scan replaced by a flat concrete-index slot scan, the coproduct walker's sorted-distinct image mirror removed (membership-only consumption), the witness obligations dispatch per witness kind (the merged per-finding dispatcher deleted), the coproduct claim split per witness shape (soundness_coproduct coverage half, soundness_coproduct_collision collision half; 18 declared harnesses), the coproduct soundness halves' declared unwind sized to the shape's concrete loop bounds (4: 2 trips plus the exit check), and the lane passes --exact (Kani 0.68's --harness filter matches by substring).
decision.rationale: The lane extends: the key family (check plus soundness) and the coproduct family (check plus both witness halves) fully verify, and the lane passes end to end — 14 of 18 declared harnesses prove at the standard, every undetermined carries a recorded disposition. The measured ladder per family, each rung recorded: the key pair's flat scan bounds every loop concretely by the cap (both key harnesses were budget-killed in symex at unwind 8 and 16 alike) — check_key 3:51.86/4.23 GB, soundness_key 3:21.35/5.01 GB; the coproduct check took the in-harness sort relocation after the mirror strip paid there (1:36.65/2.86 GB, from 2:14.03/3.30 GB); the coproduct soundness walk's mirror strip alone barely moved the formula (51.4 k VCCs) — the walk at the mirror-era unwind was the mass; fusing the re-derivation (resolve and membership in one pass, nothing materialized) plus the per-shape claim split reached formulas the scoped lane then budget-killed at unwind 8 — the mirror-era 8 unrolled past the shape's concrete loop bound and peaked at 9.93 GB uncapped; unwind 4 proved both halves in-lane (59.44 s/2.82 GB coverage, 1:08.74/2.98 GB collision). The lane's proof count stands at 14 of 18.
defects_found: the lane's harness selection matched by substring (Kani 0.68 --harness): soundness_coproduct also ran soundness_coproduct_collision, soundness_equation also ran its rhs half, and build_panic_freedom ran all five build harnesses in one pass — outcomes stayed correct because the lane takes the last verdict line, while bundled wall/peak records overstated single-harness cost (the equation lhs's recorded 5:11.59 wall included its rhs sibling); fixed with --exact per invocation, and the per-harness table re-measured
holes_found: the pullback pair (check_pullback_panic_freedom budget-killed; soundness_pullback budget-killed, one run reaching the 300 s wall at 8.09 GB) remains undetermined: its walker still carries projection/fiber bucket machinery and two sorts — the same dead weight this round's key flat scan and coproduct mirror strip removed elsewhere

check_sortedness_panic_freedom times out at the 300 s wall (5:03.39, 2.50 GB peak at the kill); its sort placement and unwind sizing are the open rungs (the merged all-families sort lives in engine_families)
build_panic_freedom stays undetermined with its claim carried by the four per-family proofs (ledger 0008's recorded disposition)

soundness_dangling solves in 3:59-4:20 on a quiet machine and crossed the 300 s wall once under back-to-back lane load; its margin is about 15 percent, a variance the lane's clean pass depends on (attempt 3 passed on an idle machine)

the provocation script's seed anchors predate the engine split (src/checks/coproducts.rs paths no longer exist), so the pass fails honestly when run; its cases need re-anchoring before the RED evidence pass extends to the new collision harness
decision.fixture_only_comparison: The walker conversion (FindingSink, mirror strip, flat scan) and the per-family partition entries touch only the engine's lane-side emission path; the parsed flavor's emissions are pinned byte-identically by the fixture corpus and contract suite (633 tests green, canonical model hashes unchanged). Cost: one key flat-scan round, one coproduct mirror-strip round, one fusion-plus-split round, one unwind-sizing round — five proofs, two scoped budget kills, one uncapped peak measurement.
